bio: Although this restaurant overlooking the Naviglio Grande canal has the appearance of a rustic building from the outside, the dining room is decorated in contemporary style and divided into several small rooms with red-brick walls and wooden ceilings. The restaurant offers a concise menu at lunchtime, while in the evening guests can choose from four tasting menus from which dishes can also be selected à la carte style. The modern cuisine is inspired by the local region and its top-quality ingredients. The wines produced by the restaurant itself are particularly good....
